desc: Formalize the characterization: coloring valid iff black cells form a down-left order ideal, i.e., no white cell has a black cell weakly southeast of it (proof via f(r) = max black column over rows >= r).
Design the dominance check: for each white (x,y), violation iff exists black (X,Y) with X>=x and Y>=y; equality of row or column counts.
Design O(M log M) sweep: sort by row descending, running max of black columns suffices (no BIT needed since only max column is queried).
Implement the Python solution reading stdin, sweeping row groups (blacks first, then whites), printing Yes/No.
Verify against the four samples by reasoning and confirm complexity O(M log M) time, O(M) memory; check edge cases (M=0, N=1, single W, same-row black/white interactions).
